environment: Linux Chromium, SwiftShader software WebGL, emulated touch. Context loss/restoration uses WEBGL_lose_context; constructor/draw failures are injected.
checks: normal campus-to-Arena startup rejects an obsolete creation notice and validates the first frame
native context restoration rebuilds resources and automatically removes the recovery overlay
manual rebuild is single-flight and captured retired-renderer callbacks cannot restore the overlay
a failed draw suspends readiness and a successful validated retry clears its error
failed automatic restoration stays actionable without a page reload; retry creates one valid renderer
keyboard and touch input resume with the same match, player and team
exit during rebuilding and re-entry leave no orphaned renderer or overlay
